messages:
mira: Heads-up: running through rollout playbook for tomorrow. I want to propose a 'shelter' UX (temporary safe-mode) instead of always saying 'degrade' 12
ash: love the name. 'shelter' feels less scary for customers. How would operator interaction look?
ash: (ops-bot): infra-bot: Canary 1/20 traffic deployed for rollout/ai-search-v3
ash: I think operators should get three actions from the topbar: observe-only (telemetry), shelter-now (apply fallback), and escalate (pager + runbook).
ash: Requirements: every shelter action must record who acted, reason, TTL, and estimated cost delta (tokens/sec cost delta) so billing can reconcile.
sam: Cost delta is important. We should show expected per-1k-tokens cost change and a projected hourly spend delta when they pick a fallback model. UI should compute that from current qps and token distribution.
elaine: Also need a quota guard. If shelter moves traffic to an on-prem/private-only model that lacks quota, console must prevent apply and show remediation steps.
kai: For triggers: keep it simple in the MVP: error_rate, latency_p95, and quality_alert_count (from eval infra). Add the ability to set a severity weight so the UI can show a ranked list of signals.
mira: Proposal for YAML policy preview to show in UI (read-only preview and editable advanced):
```yaml
shelter_policy: automatic
scope: route:/search
triggers:
  - name: http_5xx
    type: error_rate
    threshold: 0.03
    window: 300
    weight: 1.0
  - name: p95_latency
    type: latency_p95_ms
    threshold: 900
    window: 120
    weight: 0.8
fallback:
  model: small-quant-v2
  max_qps: 200
operator_override:
  enabled: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
  require_reason: true
```
rebecca: (ops-bot): audit-bot example: "{\"event_type\":\"shelter.apply\",\"actor\":\"mira\",\"scope\":\"route:/search\",\"from_model\":\"search-large-v4\",\"to_model\":\"small-quant-v2\",\"ttl_s\":3600,\"reason\":\"mitigating 5xx spike\",\"cost_delta_per_hour_usd\":\"-12.40\",\"ts\":1771000500}"
sam: For dashboards we must emit metric tags: shelter.v1.trigger_source=(auto|operator), shelter.v1.fallback_model, shelter.v1.cost_delta_usd. Also emit boolean tag shelter.v1.simulated when running in simulation mode.
elaine: Simulation mode is a must. Let console run rules against live telemetry but only emit 'would_shelter' events. Operators can seed a timeframe and get a list of hypothetical events and a cost report.
kai: Implementation notes: operator override records should be stored as immutable events (append-only). TTL expiry should generate a separate audit event (shelter.ttl_expired) so playback can reconstruct timeline.
mira: UX: when operator applies shelter, show a confirmation modal with live estimate: "Applying shelter will reduce cost by $12.40/hr but may increase latency for 1% of requests. Provide short reason (required)". Provide checkboxes: notify-on-call, rollback-if-quality-drop.
sam: On the API side, add endpoint: POST /rollouts/{id}/shelter-actions with body {action: apply|observe|cancel, ttl_s, reason, simulated:false}. Response should include snapshot of policy hashes before/after and cost_estimate.
elaine: Backfill plan: migrate existing fallbacks to shelter_policy=automatic default. Add a migration flag to set notify-only for existing rollouts so we don't surprise customers.
kai: MVP decisions: no chained shelters (single fallback target) and operator overrides require explicit cancel to revert. Chained targets behind feature flag for v2.
mira: Also add a small inline 'why' card in rollout timeline: top 3 signals and short explanation (e.g., "p95 spiked to 1.2s for 6m; quality alerts 4/10 prompts"). Link to trace and the eval diff.
ash: One more thing: make shelter actions opt-in for accounts under trial; require explicit feature flag on billing side. We must also redact any PII from audit events.
ash: I'll pair with product to mock wireframes this afternoon. Who can write the telemetry spec?
sam: I'll draft telemetry + API RFC tonight and include sample metrics and audit-schema.
elaine: I'll own the trigger definitions and migration playbook.
ops-bot: infra-bot: "Note: quota check failed for fallback small-quant-v2 in us-west-2 for org:acme-inc"
mira: great catch. Console should surface that as an actionable error with links to request quota increase.
sam: Ok, agreement: ship observe-only + apply-with-audit + simulation mode for MVP. Followups: RFC from @sam, telemetry spec, and UI mock from @mira.
